prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-20273
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Just a quick and friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-20273 for 1236.76 USDC, which is now due. We appreciate your continued partnership and want to ensure there are no delays in settling this balance.

To proceed with the payment, please transfer the amount to our standard vendor wallet: 0x7f846791c68d086d17b57f9750aa1747d81ae6a6. This is the same address we have used for previous transactions, so no updates are needed on your end.

If you have already sent the payment, please disregard this note. If you have any questions or need a copy of the invoice again, just let us know. We’re here to help!

Thanks so much,
The Elmstead Media Team
